nen_ability.examplenenaddon.spark_fist.d: For ten seconds, or three hits, every punch also strikes with a spark of Nen.
Hold to charge, then let go: a burst of Nen hurts everything near you, harder the longer you held.
Loose a fast wisp of Nen that follows and fights for you for thirty seconds. Press again to call it off.
nen_vow.examplenenaddon.spark_offering.d: Each use of Spark Fist costs one glowstone dust. Using it without the dust breaks the vow.
nen_imprint.examplenenaddon.marked.desc: Worn as armor, it makes you a little faster for every grade.
The bound player may not sprint.
